d: Madagascar—a unique island nation, often called the 'eighth continent' of the world and known as a "natural laboratory of evolution." It is home to the extraordinary world of lemurs, where centuries-old traditions like 'Famadihana' remain alive to this day. There is so much that is truly special about Madagascar—things you absolutely ought to know. So, come along with us on a journey to Madagascar, right here on Infinity Stream.
